name: Switch / Toggle
summary: Immediate binary on/off setting backed by one native checkbox with switch semantics, stable labeling, form value, validation, and three visual sizes.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Label wrapper that aligns the hidden native input, visual switch, and visible label.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native checkbox input that owns checked, focus, disabled, and form behavior.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Stable visible label text that does not change with checkedness.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the label when the on state is required.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Invalid switch value using the shared Error field hierarchy.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Validated switch value using the shared Success field hierarchy.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Switch value that needs attention using the shared Warning field hierarchy.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover on an available switch.

states.name: checked
states.description: Checked state driven by the native checkbox input.

states.name: requiredInvalid
states.description: Native required switch whose current off state is invalid; invalidity is semantic and is not styled without the Error variant.

states.name: errorFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Error switch with its semantic outer ring.

states.name: successFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Success switch with its semantic outer ring.

states.name: warningFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Warning switch with its semantic outer ring.

behavior.name: nativeControl
behavior.description: Switch preserves native checkbox behavior while exposing switch semantics for assistive technology.

behavior.name: checkedState
behavior.description: Native checked is the sole accessibility and visual state; redundant manually synchronized aria-checked is not required.

behavior.name: keyboardToggle
behavior.description: Keyboard users toggle the switch with Space through the native input.

behavior.name: checkedOwnership
attributes: checked establishes default checkedness in static HTML
checked or defaultChecked in framework adapters
behavior.description: Static Web delegates live checkedness to the native input; controlled adapters bind that same live property without a mirror input.

behavior.name: immediateEffect
behavior.description: Consumers apply and persist the setting immediately; pending, retry, and side effects remain target-owned.

behavior.name: validationSemantics
behavior.description: Switch owns visual validation and native invalid state while Field Wrapper owns static feedback content.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Stable visible accessible label that does not change between on and off.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation independent from checked state.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Establishes default checkedness in static HTML; framework adapters may bind the live checked property.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Participates in native required-choice validation and shows the standardized decorative marker beside the label.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Native value submitted when the switch is on.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for helper or validation feedback.

accessibility: Use a native checkbox input with role="switch" or an equivalent platform switch primitive.
Provide a stable visible label that does not change when checkedness changes.
Keep checked, disabled, required, name, and submitted value synchronized with the native input.
Support Space to toggle the switch and expose native input and change events.
Do not expose indeterminate state; use Checkbox for mixed selection.
Use Switch for immediate binary settings and keep persistence, pending, and failure recovery target-owned.
Use aria-invalid only for Error and associate external feedback with aria-describedby.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/forms.css with a visually hidden native checkbox, required role=switch, logical thumb travel, and native form ownership.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render native checkbox switches with the same class contract.
